statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: This afternoon and tonight. Another round of scattered thunderstorms is expected this afternoon and evening along a cold front. The level of the severe threat remains uncertain, but the highest threat will be in northwestern Pennsylvania. The strongest storms may produce damaging wind gusts and large hail.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: This afternoon and tonight. Another round of scattered thunderstorms is expected this afternoon and evening along a cold front. The level of the severe threat remains uncertain, but the highest threat will be in northwestern Pennsylvania. The strongest storms may produce damaging wind gusts and large hail.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Monday through Saturday. Hazardous weather is not expected at this time.
